question: Which of the following reactions is NOT an exothermic reaction?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Photosynthesis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Photosynthesis** is an **endothermic reaction**, meaning it absorbs energy.
 
• In this process, plants use **sunlight** to convert **carbon dioxide** and **water** into **glucose** and **oxygen**.
 
• It requires the input of **light energy** from the sun, which is absorbed by **chlorophyll**.
 
• Since it absorbs energy rather than releasing it, photosynthesis is not exothermic.
 
• This process is crucial for producing **organic compounds** and maintaining the **oxygen levels** in the atmosphere.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dilution of a strong acid**__

 __
 
• This is an **exothermic reaction** as it releases heat when the strong acid is diluted with water.
 
 
 
• **Respiration**__
 __
 
• Respiration is an **exothermic process** because it releases energy by breaking down glucose in the presence of oxygen.
 
 
 
• **Burning of natural gas**__
 
 
• The burning of natural gas is a highly **exothermic reaction**, releasing a significant amount of heat and light energy.
 
• Natural gas primarily consists of **methane** which combusts to produce **carbon dioxide** and **water**.
